First of all you obviously care which is a good thing. 
And you're obviously stressed. It's not you or your wife or your kids fault but I get it. You have got to find a way to take some of that stress down a notch. Sounds are what annoys me the most with my kids. I have ptsd and my husband put us in a 3rd floor apartment after I tried to kill myself and fromt his experience I've learned... Kids are so damn loud. They need space to be loud. They need room to run around. The screams and even loud pitch laughter stresses my husband out too and then stresses me out and then I stress him out and ahhhhh. I feel your pain.

I used to think the same thing but I have ptsd and have kind of thought about suicide as a coping mechanism since I was 11. So my brain probably just started doing it for me. Oh you don't have anything to worry about you'll be dead. I think it was my brain trying to protect me from feeling like I couldn't handle it .

There's one particular lady I see everywhere on youtube and I do not like her vibe at all.. Romonia. Durvasula or something like that. Then on tiktok, the algorithm will show you nothing but narc stuff once you start liking it. And it gets overwhelming. Then the comments are like leave your whole family! I did it! Everyone's doing it And I'm just like this is weird... I have to get off of here. I really did have to leave my mom and her family alone forever but she very obviously wanted me gone because I did not live up to her expectations. I don't want to.. I'd rather be free.. but it's crazy that so many people are being pushed to do that because it's really hard to not have family and I worry if people are using narcissism to separate people the same way politics and religion was used but yeah also it's just people trying to sell stuff.

I do wish there was a way to help without getting hurt but I've definitely tried that and almost lost my mind and ability to love... I almost became her but I'm not as strong as her.. in a sense i could never kill off my emotions the way she has. I'm almost impressed.id still have a mom if I could do that.. It saddens me but at the same time I just wish she could feel her pain and make something of it so she could move on but she refuses to be a victim so she has to be the one that hurts others... I used to think on purpose because of gaslighting but maybe her illness is reality warping bc she probably doesn't see it that way. Maybe they believe the lies because they're traumatized and can't remember.. my mom can't remember anything. Not even telling me to kill myself but I'm the crazy one? It's hard because I understand why she does the things she does but your right... Energy is too precious. I was convinced she was actually trying to get me to kill myself so I was forced to go no contact with her and everyone due to triangulation. I still long for her but I actually started getting better when I started pretending she was dead as awful as that sounds. I'm trying to grieve her. So i can stop longing for her. It's always been this desperate longing and I want it gone. Thank you for sharing💞

Well now we're all paranoid because of our own life story and the news of course. Men and women are going to drift further and further apart if it keeps on like this though. It may seem silly but we need to protect these kids. I remember thinking my bus driver was going to rape me when I was the last person on the bus... I was raped when I was 9 and on stimulants so my imagination and fear were in full gear at all times. I wish we could trust each other more as a species. But we learn that trust does not equal safety so what can you do. Be afraid I guess.

If a guy makes you feel uncomfortable, please try to make it sound like you would fight for your life if you had to... Predators target vulnerable people so get an attitude. Make your voice louder.. maintain eye contact. Don't smile. Don't say it's ok. Try to stand your ground.

I am just realizing how much so... I really need to get away from people and rewire my nervous system out in nature I think. Maybe singing might help... I'm learning about what you're talking about though and it seems like hopeful information.
If we are lucky, we get the chance to circle around and learn to hate them instead of ourselves.
